title: 専門ゼミ(ロボティクス学科)
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III (Robotics)
educationalGoal: (1)Predict robotics issues that could be encountered in Design Project III. (2)Learn how to use your acquired knowledge and techniques to address these issues. (3)Learn how to comprehensively apply your ability as an engineer. (4)Learn the importance of collaboration with regional society (especially the local community).
advice: Issues to be addressed in Design Project III are presented. Students will understand the knowledge and skills required to carry out their senior project and identify where supplemental knowledge is needed. During the course of this seminar, students will clarify the purpose and action plan for their project, and finally make a project proposal. Note: Details will be provided during the first class.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: If you do not earn credit for this course, you cannot take Design Project III.

activityGoals.body: Clarify the purpose and action plan of your design project.
Understand important robotic technologies in each laboratory.
Apply your basic skills to develop a new robotic system during the project.
Decide the theme of the project, and summarize the research proposal.
Understand safety management for conducting experiments and developing the project.
See your future course and decide the direction you should follow.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand technical issues in engineering fields, and identify a project theme independently. (2) Submit an appropriate research proposal with clear goals and action plans for the project theme. (3) Collect articles related to the project theme, and study them to understand the research background and objectives. (4) Understand safety management guidelines and engineering ethics for conducting experiments and research safely in the laboratory.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand technical issues in engineering fields, and identify a project theme with professor assistance. (2) Submit a research proposal with clear goals and action plans for the project theme. (3) Collect articles related to the project theme. (4) Understand safety management guidelines and engineering ethics for conducting experiments and research safely in the laboratory.
